title: Noise from the positive sign
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and $y\in\{−1,1\}$. Under coordinate noise with parameter $\rho$, started at $1$, the probability of output $y$ is $(1+\rho)/2$ if $y=1$, and $(1-\rho)/2$ otherwise.
